title: Hello
description: hello, the first frame of a node: who it is and which assistant it is for.

protocol.description: The version the node speaks, major.minor.

nodeId.description: The stable id of the node, chosen by it once and kept (a UUID).

name.description: The short name of the node (desk, phone, kitchen): its tools are offered as <name>__<tool>.

kind.description: What it is: desktop, phone, pi, car...

joi.description: The id of the assistant this connection is for.

parts.description: What the node implements; unknown parts are ignored.

token.description: The credentials, for a client that cannot send an Authorization header on the upgrade.

resumed.description: True when the node connects again after it lost the connection (since 1.3): she does not greet the user for it. Null or false for a new start.
